propositions: _check_work_landed unconditionally invokes _referencing_commits to scan full git history before checking if file impact union is empty, performing unnecessary work when no impact is declared
closing a ticket with empty accepted-scope file impact should return before commit discovery without calling _referencing_commits
the _check_file_impact_vs_diff guard that prevents landing enforcement on empty impact union occurs after the expensive commit discovery, making that discovery redundant for the no-impact case
a cheap early guard based on _union_file_impact must be added to _check_work_landed to skip commit discovery when ticket and accepted descendants have no file impact
impact-present paths must retain full referencing-commit discovery and existing diff enforcement to preserve descendant credit and landing verification
